top_modules.name: kernelledger.worker
top_modules.doc: Standalone worker. Intentionally imports no KernelLedger modules.

top_modules.name: kernelledger.supervisor
top_modules.doc: Authenticated asyncio supervisor; sole writer of runtime state.

top_modules.name: kernelledger.desktop.server
top_modules.doc: Supervisor-owned durable desktop operations, input ownership and committed feeds.

top_modules.name: kernelledger.cli
top_modules.doc: KernelLedger CLI. Inspection never starts a worker or supervisor.

top_modules.name: kernelledger.experiments
top_modules.doc: Experimental explicit PyTorch training snapshots, outside the v4 worker API. Factories are supplied by the caller at restore, never deserialized from bytes. The caller owns the idle training boundary and dataset cursor/drain rule.

top_modules.name: kernelledger.sharing
top_modules.doc: Read-only output views and verified sharing artifacts.

top_modules.name: kernelledger.source
top_modules.doc: Revision-checked source transactions. Only this module publishes tracked source.

top_modules.name: kernelledger.gpu.cooperative
top_modules.doc: Opt-in cooperative training checkpoints; importing this module loads no framework. All registered-object mutations must use training_step(). Background data loaders must be drained by the supplied callback. Restore belongs in a fresh proces

top_modules.name: kernelledger.artifacts
top_modules.doc: Experimental v5 chunk store. Independent of the v4 runtime ledger. Every published object is a root until explicitly released. Writers, transfers, and GC serialize on an OS lock; leases protect transitive closure between calls. The format i

top_modules.name: kernelledger.ledger
top_modules.doc: Single-writer SQLite execution history; readers never create a database.

top_modules.name: kernelledger.notebook
top_modules.doc: Tracked notebook source and standard-library ipynb conversion.

top_modules.name: kernelledger.desktop.helper
top_modules.doc: Offline desktop source and inspection server. Never launches notebook code.

top_modules.name: kernelledger.gpu.portable
top_modules.doc: Explicit typed PyTorch values; no pickle or framework-native loaders. Call capture only at an application-owned idle boundary. This prototype does not change the standalone v4 worker's checkpoint or busy-refusal contract.

top_modules.name: kernelledger.desktop.contracts
top_modules.doc: Protocol request catalog used for stdlib validation and published JSON schemas.

top_modules.name: kernelledger.supervisor.platform
top_modules.doc: OS-owned locks, child process lifetime, and token permissions.

top_modules.name: kernelledger.gpu.manifest
top_modules.doc: Framework-free validation of the experimental portable tensor format.

top_modules.name: kernelledger.blobs
top_modules.doc: Durable immutable content-addressed payloads.

top_modules.name: kernelledger.gpu.backends.capabilities
top_modules.doc: Inventory never imports a framework. Active probing is a separate process.

top_modules.name: kernelledger.gpu.notebook
top_modules.doc: Explicit installed plugin bridge for the standalone notebook worker. Only register() imports PyTorch. This module never writes a notebook ledger. Captured sources are retained in an owned temporary directory on reconstruction.

top_modules.name: kernelledger.desktop.protocol
top_modules.doc: Bounded JSON framing and shared validation for socket and stdio clients.

top_modules.name: kernelledger.gpu.backends.probe
top_modules.doc: Disposable active probe. Invoked by absolute path with an isolated interpreter.

top_modules.name: kernelledger.execution.targets
top_modules.doc: Read-only target identity. Credentials and machine paths are never tracked.

top_modules.name: kernelledger.registry
top_modules.doc: Runtime hints. Authentication, never a pid, establishes liveness.

top_modules.name: kernelledger.git_state
top_modules.doc: Read-only experimental source/state association checks. No Git hooks installed.

top_modules.name: kernelledger
top_modules.doc: KernelLedger's local notebook runtime.
